name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-connector
description: Company databases for agents: MongoDB, SQL Server, PostgreSQL; read-only, writes on approval.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CONNECTOR_VAULT_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Vault's address, where the sources and their connection strings are declared.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CONNECTOR_VAULT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A Vault token that may read and list under the sources' path and nothing else.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CONNECTOR_APPROVAL_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The key the dashboard's door asks for before a person allows a write; empty keeps writes off.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CONNECTOR_WORKSPACES_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Folder the platform's working copies lie under, where exports land. Default: /workspaces.
